latest.description: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.

latest.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
latest.description: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.

latest.description: Brokerage firms may put future IPO limits in place for investors who sell their Anthropic stake too soon.
